mapper.select: SELECT value::text FROM sys_setting WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scope = 'global' AND setting_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_setting (tenant_id, scope, setting_key, value, description, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, 'global', #{key}, to_jsonb(#{value}::bigint), '运行期可调参数（页面可改）', now())
